title.narrative: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions avoided (tonnes CO2eq) with EU support

description.narrative: SDG 13 Climate ActionFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: The whole LF for this intervention is basedshared with the Contribution Agreement NDICI ASIA2023 448851 Inclusive and Climatesmart lnvestment Financing in the Livestock sector in the Republic of Uzbekistan Tranche 2 which is providing 2nd tranche of EU financing totalling 115M without fees to the overall project. To prevent double counting the indicator values will be split pro rata basis 6040 between two interventions as indicated in the respective contracts. For example for Outcome 1 GHG emissions avoided target of the overall LF is 31000 tCO2 where 18600 t will be attributed to intervention 26230 while 12400t to the LF of INTV26231 tranche 2.
